subject: maths
title: Shapes, Direction and Movement - Patterns and Directions

steps.title: Patterns and robot turns
steps.prompt: Let us explore together!

options.label: Red circle, blue square, red circle, blue square. Choose what comes next.
The robot faces up. It turns right. Which way does it face now?
Take three steps forwards, then one backwards. How many steps forwards from the start?

steps.hint: Say the two-shape part aloud twice, then start it again.
steps.explanation: Continue a repeating part and use the direction a robot faces.
steps.shortExplanation: Make, count or compare the objects. Explain what changed.

mathWorkshop.title: Patterns and robot turns
mathWorkshop.goal: Continue a repeating part and use the direction a robot faces.

tasks.prompt: Red circle, blue square, red circle, blue square. Choose what comes next.
tasks.feedback: The repeating part is red circle, blue square. It starts again with red circle.
tasks.hint: Say the two-shape part aloud twice, then start it again.

tasks.prompt: The robot faces up. It turns right. Which way does it face now?
tasks.feedback: A right turn changes its facing direction from up to right.
tasks.hint: Keep it in the same place. Only change the way it faces.

tasks.prompt: Take three steps forwards, then one backwards. How many steps forwards from the start?
tasks.feedback: Three forwards and one back leaves two steps forwards from the start.
tasks.hint: Start at zero. Count three forward jumps, then one backward jump.

parentReview.en: Guided practice is ungraded. Completion records the child doing the activities, not a book-question score.

steps.title: What comes next
steps.prompt: What comes next in the pattern?
steps.hint: Say the pattern aloud and find the part that repeats.
steps.explanation: The repeating part is red circle, blue square.
steps.shortExplanation: The repeating part is red circle, blue square.

steps.title: Shape pattern
steps.prompt: What comes next in this pattern?
steps.hint: Say the shapes aloud. Which part repeats?
steps.explanation: Two triangles and a circle repeat. The next shape is a triangle.
steps.shortExplanation: Two triangles and a circle repeat. The next shape is a triangle.

steps.title: Pattern gaps
steps.prompt: Fill the next two gaps: red, blue, blue, red, blue, blue, __, __.
steps.hint: Find red, blue, blue, then keep saying it.
steps.explanation: The repeating part is red, blue, blue.
steps.shortExplanation: The repeating part is red, blue, blue.

steps.title: A pattern that repeats
steps.prompt: Which row is a repeating pattern of two shapes?
steps.hint: Find the part that repeats. Does it come again and again?
steps.explanation: In b the part circle, square comes again and again: it repeats three times.
steps.shortExplanation: In b the part circle, square comes again and again: it repeats three times.

source.answerKeyText: Any pattern where a part clearly repeats at least twice.

steps.title: Steps from the start
steps.prompt: Walk 3 steps forwards and 1 backwards. How many steps from the start?
steps.hint: Step forward three times, then back once. Where are you now?
steps.explanation: Three forwards and one backwards leaves 2 steps forwards.
steps.shortExplanation: Three forwards and one backwards leaves 2 steps forwards.

steps.title: Is a cube flat?
steps.prompt: A cube is a flat 2D shape.
steps.hint: Could you hold a cube in your hand?
steps.explanation: A cube is solid, so it is a 3D shape.
steps.shortExplanation: A cube is solid, so it is a 3D shape.

source.answerKeyText: False. A cube is solid — it is 3D.

steps.title: Square and rectangle
steps.prompt: Compare a square and a rectangle.

options.label: Only the square must have 4 equal sides.
They each have 4 sides and 4 corners.

steps.hint: Count the sides of each. Are all the sides the same length?
steps.explanation: Both have 4 sides. A square has all 4 sides equal.
steps.shortExplanation: Both have 4 sides. A square has all 4 sides equal.

source.answerKeyText:
Same: 4 sides and 4 corners. Different: a square's sides are all equal; a rectangle has two
long and two short sides.

steps.title: Counting corners
steps.prompt: Sort the shapes by their corners.
steps.hint: Touch and count the corners of each shape.
steps.explanation: Circle: 0 corners. Triangle: 3. Square and rectangle: 4.
steps.shortExplanation: Circle: 0 corners. Triangle: 3. Square and rectangle: 4.

steps.title: Colour pattern
steps.prompt: red, yellow, red, yellow, ... What comes next?
steps.hint: Say the colours aloud. What came after yellow before?
steps.explanation: Red and yellow take turns, so red comes next.
steps.shortExplanation: Red and yellow take turns, so red comes next.

steps.title: Square sides
steps.prompt: How many sides does a square have?
steps.hint: Touch each side of a square and count.
steps.explanation: A square has four straight sides, all the same length.
steps.shortExplanation: A square has four straight sides, all the same length.

steps.title: Moving backwards
steps.prompt: Moving the way your back faces is moving...
steps.hint: Your face looks forwards. Which way does your back face?
steps.explanation: Moving the way your back faces is moving backwards.
steps.shortExplanation: Moving the way your back faces is moving backwards.

steps.title: Turning
steps.prompt: The triangle turned. What changed?
steps.hint: Did it get bigger, change colour, or point a new way?
steps.explanation: Turning changes the way something points or faces. Its size and colour stay the same.
steps.shortExplanation: Turning changes the way something points or faces. Its size and colour stay the same.

steps.title: 3D shapes
steps.prompt: A 3D shape is...
steps.hint: Think of a ball or a box. Could you pick them up?
steps.explanation: A 3D shape is solid, so you can pick it up.
steps.shortExplanation: A 3D shape is solid, so you can pick it up.

steps.title: Name the pentagon
steps.prompt: What is this shape called?
steps.hint: Count the straight sides. A pentagon has 5.
steps.explanation: It has 5 straight sides and 5 corners, so it is a pentagon.
steps.shortExplanation: It has 5 straight sides and 5 corners, so it is a pentagon.

steps.title: Hexagon sides
steps.prompt: How many straight sides does a hexagon have?
steps.hint: Touch each straight side once as you count.
steps.explanation: Count each side once: a hexagon has 6 straight sides and 6 corners.
steps.shortExplanation: Count each side once: a hexagon has 6 straight sides and 6 corners.

steps.title: Above the table
steps.prompt: Where is the ball?
steps.hint: Is the ball higher than the table top, or lower?
steps.explanation: The ball is higher than the table top, so it is above the table.
steps.shortExplanation: The ball is higher than the table top, so it is above the table.

steps.title: Under the table
steps.prompt: Where is the ball?
steps.hint: Look at the table top. Is the ball over it or below it?
steps.explanation: The table top is over the ball, so the ball is under the table.
steps.shortExplanation: The table top is over the ball, so the ball is under the table.

steps.title: Behind the box
steps.prompt: Where is the ball?
steps.hint: Part of the ball is hidden. What is hiding it?
steps.explanation: The box hides part of the ball, so the ball is behind the box.
steps.shortExplanation: The box hides part of the ball, so the ball is behind the box.

steps.title: Squares on a grid
steps.prompt: The robot is in square B2. It goes 2 squares forwards. Which square is it in now?
steps.hint: Find B along the bottom and 2 up the side. Then move up one square at a time.
steps.explanation: Forwards is up the grid: B2, then B3, then B4.
steps.shortExplanation: Forwards is up the grid: B2, then B3, then B4.

stickers.meaning: Something that repeats in the same way.

homeActivities.text: Continue a two-shape or two-sound pattern, then invent one. Play robot commands in a clear space: forwards, backwards, left and right.
homeActivities.textAr: كمّلوا نمط من شكلين أو صوتين، وبعدين اخترعوا نمط جديد. والعبوا لعبة الروبوت في مكان فاضي: لقدّام، لورا، شمال، يمين.
homeActivities.safety: An adult supervises. Keep small objects away from younger children. An adult handles scissors. Use water at the sink, away from electrical items.
homeActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. خلّي الحاجات الصغيرة بعيد عن الأطفال الأصغر، والكبير يمسك المقص. أنشطة المية تكون عند الحوض وبعيد عن الكهرباء.

parentNote.en: Every question is answered in the app; each goal has a home activity to try together. Estimate first; a guess is not a scored answer.
parentNote.ar: كل الأسئلة الطفل بيحلها جوه البرنامج، ولكل هدف نشاط تعملوه مع بعض في البيت. التوقع الأول مش إجابة عليها درجات.
